title: Engine F3 — Active-effect, concentration, and owned-entity lifecycle
description:
Implement duration-bearing active effects, concentration, persistent actors, summoned/created entity ownership, repeat-on-damage and repeat-save triggers, and cleanup/termination.

Snapshot membership: 31 magic-item hook references at 4384f25, plus lifecycle gaps across spells (19.4.1), features (19.3.2), creatures (19.4.3), hazards (19.4.4), and rule:conflict.

Likely child boundaries (confirm against the ledger before creating any):
  concentration vs summoned-entity ownership vs effect termination

EXECUTABLE SCENARIO — never by magic-item hook count or by individual record.

generated ledger/predicate is authoritative. No acceptance test may require a
